about: 2.59 confluence alert (Mandeep, 11 Nov 2026, Bank Nifty breakout at 10:29-10:30: new day high + flag breakout + heavy PE writing in the same minute, but no pop-up because each was strength 2; 'jo best ho vo karo'). When several different alert types point the same way on the same symbol within a few minutes, one 'Signals agree' alert says so with a pop-up, a sound and Telegram (when set). It does not change Focus, the risk check or any paper account's rules (the main account does not trade this alert type); the test bench records it, so the multiverse grades it like every other signal before anything trades it. Change the numbers here.
